name: Jerry Carl
bio: a Representative from Alabama; born in Mobile, Mobile County, Ala., June 17, 1958; graduated from Sylacauga High School, Sylacauga, Ala., 1977; attended Lake City Community College, Lake City, Fla.; business owner; entrepreneur; sales representative; commissioner, Mobile County, Ala., 2012-2020, president, 2015-2016, 2019-2020; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2021-January 3, 2025); unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
